corrections.reason: Amharic ምንዠት (cud, corresponding to Ge'ez ወያመሰኵዕ) is clearly printed; ዠት was misread as ዘኀ.
Andemta gloss for መዓረ ገዳም (wild/forest honey) is የጫካ ማር; ጫካ was misread as ማን due to ink bleed.
First syllable of እገሌ (so-and-so, baptismal formula placeholder) at the end of line 30 is 6th-order እ, misread as አ.
Continuation of እገሌ (so-and-so); 1st-order ገ was misread as 3rd-order ጊ.
Negative verb አይሰጥ ('does neither give sonship?') was misread as non-word ያአሰጥ.
